$description: Structure: the text face and every type role's size and line height are shared by all finishes. A finish may change only the display face (display and title roles).

text.$description: All interface text in every finish. Chinese falls back to the system (PingFang SC, then Noto Sans SC).

mono.$description: Code, keyboard keys, IDs and token names.

weight.$description: Geist is variable, so the medium and strong stops sit between the usual 500 and 600 for a finer hierarchy. Tune by eye in the docs.

type.$description: Type roles. Use roles, never raw sizes or weights. Geist has no optical-size axis, so each role carries its own tracking: tighter for large roles, slightly open for the smallest.

display.$description: Hero and marketing headlines. Uses the finish's display face.

title.$description: Page titles and empty-state titles. Uses the finish's display face.

heading.$description: Section and card headings. Always the text face.

label.$description: Control labels: tabs, form labels and badges. Controls also trim the line box to cap height and baseline. Button uses its own reference-defined type role.

button.$description: Button action labels in every finish: 14px Geist medium with an 18px line box. Do not trim this role; the default Button adds 8px above and below the line box to match the approved Figma reference.
